about: Every fact, step and limit this update says or shows, with the source's own words. Sources: three OpenAI pages and Todd's own ChatGPT Business Hub screens, all read and captured on Nov 12, 2026 (Central) in the browser on his PC during the live chat he started for this lesson (2:46 pm). OpenAI's pages answer our page reader and WebFetch with a 403, so each was read in full as text in his browser and the passages used were captured there; the captures in 04_scene/assets/ are the record a reviewer checks. The lesson has no numbers. It names no person and no business but OpenAI, ChatGPT, Persona, Shopify, Google (the send line) and ProofNotFluff (ours). Not said, though the pages say it: Business Agents, product feeds, insights, the blue check, the claim invitation and locked listing cases, dispute of ownership, what can be edited after approval (website, description, category, logo, policies). Not claimed: that Business Hub is missing from anyone else's sidebar (one account was seen); that trades businesses are or are not 'local stores' (the help page's own words are used and the voice says 'might not'); anything about ranking beyond OpenAI's own 'doesn't guarantee'.

changed.what: OpenAI opened Businesses in ChatGPT and Business Hub in beta

sources.confirms: dated November 10, 2026; 'We're introducing Businesses in ChatGPT in beta'; through Business Hub 'businesses can claim their business, manage their information, and see insights'; subtitle 'Claim your business, keep your information current'

sources.title: Setting up your business on ChatGPT
sources.date: shown as 'Updated: 23 hours ago' when read
sources.how: read in full as text at 2:49 pm in the Claude desktop app's browser on Todd's PC; captured at 3:22 pm and 3:29 pm in Chrome on his PC
sources.confirms: 'Sign in to ChatGPT, and open Business Hub from the sidebar. Search for your business by name.'; 'Use one of the verification methods offered for your business, such as phone, business email, website domain, or Shopify.'; 'If you run an eligible online business, you may see an option to add it. Local stores and restaurants can currently claim only an existing U.S. listing.'; 'You'll need to complete identity verification with Persona before you can publish changes to your business information'; 'OpenAI reviews your Persona verification submission and emails you its decision or a request for more information.'; FAQ: 'It doesn't guarantee increased visibility or give you direct control over ChatGPT's independent recommendations.'; website domain method: 'add the TXT record shown in ChatGPT to your domain's DNS settings'; heading 'Verify with your business phone'

claims.said: Your business might already be listed in ChatGPT
claims.words: OpenAI may create, maintain, and display a business listing ... regardless of whether you claim, manage, or cease managing it; Local stores and restaurants can currently claim only an existing U.S. listing
claims.note: 'might': no page says every business is listed

claims.said: OpenAI just opened Business Hub. It's in beta
claims.words: We're introducing Businesses in ChatGPT in beta ... Through Business Hub
claims.note: 'just': dated Nov 10, 2026, two days before the build; 'beta' is said aloud

claims.said: it's where you claim your business and keep its info current
claims.words: Claim your business, keep your information current

claims.said: Here's the catch if you're local. You might not be able to add yourself. OpenAI says local stores and restaurants can only claim a listing that's already there. U.S. only, for now
claims.words: If you run an eligible online business, you may see an option to add it. Local stores and restaurants can currently claim only an existing U.S. listing.
claims.note: 'for now' is the page's 'currently'; 'might not' because the page names local stores and restaurants and does not define other local businesses

claims.said: One. Go to Business Hub. OpenAI says it's in your ChatGPT sidebar
claims.words: Sign in to ChatGPT, and open Business Hub from the sidebar.

claims.said: If it's not, type chatgpt dot com, slash business hub
claims.words: his sidebar did not list Business Hub; the address bar on his own screenshot reads chatgpt.com/business-hub (followed by the create flow's own ?create=1&creation_session=1)
claims.note: on screen the address is written exactly, with its hyphen: chatgpt.com/business-hub. Claude opened the Business Hub page at exactly https://chatgpt.com/business-hub in his signed-in Chrome at 3:06 pm (the browser tool's own log); the capture that shows an address bar is his 3:27 pm screenshot (asset hub-address)

claims.words: Search for your business by name.

claims.said: By continuing, you accept OpenAI's terms
claims.words: By continuing, you accept OpenAI's Businesses in ChatGPT Terms.

claims.said: They say its AI assistant may call your business for its users. You can opt out
claims.words: By using Business Hub, you agree OpenAI's AI assistant may make calls to you on behalf of our users. You can opt out here.

claims.said: And you agree not to bring certain claims against OpenAI
claims.words: Covenant Not to Sue. You ... covenant and agree not to assert or commence ... any Covered Claim against OpenAI or any of its Affiliates
claims.note: 'certain claims' stands for the terms' defined 'Covered Claim'; the video does not explain the definition and tells the viewer to read the small print

claims.said: We searched ours. Not listed. It offered to create one
claims.note: Todd typed the search himself in this live chat (3:09 pm: 'I'll type it myself')

claims.said: OpenAI says that's for eligible online businesses
claims.words: If you run an eligible online business, you may see an option to add it.

claims.said: Three. Prove it's yours. OpenAI lists a business phone, a business email, your website domain, or Shopify
claims.words: Use one of the verification methods offered for your business, such as phone, business email, website domain, or Shopify. The method's own heading on the same page: Verify with your business phone
claims.note: 'business phone' is the page's own name for the phone method (asset help-phone); the summary sentence says 'phone' (asset help-claim)

claims.said: Ours asked for a DNS record
claims.words: Verify that you control proofnotfluff.com. Add this TXT record to the DNS settings for proofnotfluff.com
claims.note: Todd went through the create flow himself and sent this screenshot at 3:27 pm

claims.said: Four. Before any change goes live, there's an identity check with Persona
claims.words: You'll need to complete identity verification with Persona before you can publish changes to your business information

claims.said: Then OpenAI reviews it and emails you its decision
claims.words: OpenAI reviews your Persona verification submission and emails you its decision or a request for more information.

claims.said: And claiming it doesn't guarantee ChatGPT recommends you more. OpenAI says so itself
claims.words: It doesn't guarantee increased visibility or give you direct control over ChatGPT's independent recommendations.

claims.said: Save this, and send it to whoever runs your Google listing
claims.note: the send line; it claims nothing about Google

posts: Queued first for the evening slot on Nov 12, 2026 (8:13 pm Central), two days after the announcement; the slug's date is its place in line, not its post day. If it has not posted by Nov 17, re-read the help page and the terms before it does, and drop 'just'.
